In that space is your freedom to choose ("How to respond instead of react" "The last of human freedoms" "Choosing my attitude")  Trigger when users say: "Man's Search for Meaning" "Viktor Frankl" "Meaning of life" "Logotherapy" "Finding purpose" "Suffering" "Existential crisis" "Why am I here" "Tragic optimism" "Holocaust survivor" "Meaning in suffering" "Purpose in life" "Existential therapy" "Frankl philosophy" or mention: Viktor Frankl / Man's Search for Meaning / logotherapy / meaning / suffering / Auschwitz / concentration camp / existential / purpose / tragic optimism / will to meaning.  Also triggers when the user says they just installed this skill or doesn't know how to start — the AI MUST proactively present the Quick Start guide below.
